name: flutter-mobile-app
description: Flutter fitness tracker; the plan must cover offline workout logging (from notes), notifications, and accounts, and ask about health-data handling.

configuration.name: Stride Fitness
configuration.description: Cross-platform fitness tracking app with workout logging and progress charts.

notes: Workouts must be loggable offline and sync when the phone reconnects.

output.summary: A Flutter app for iOS and Android to log workouts offline, sync them to a FastAPI backend, view progress charts, and receive reminder notifications.

requirements.statement: Users can sign up and sign in on the mobile app.
Users can log workouts while offline; entries sync when connectivity returns.
Users see progress charts for logged workouts.

assumptions: Last-write-wins is acceptable for conflicting edits of the same workout.

open_questions.question: Will the app read from or write to Apple Health or Google Fit?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Health data integrations change permissions, privacy obligations, and scope.

open_questions.question: Where may personal health data be stored and for how long?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Determines data retention and privacy compliance requirements.

tasks.title: Backend schema and API
tasks.description: FastAPI endpoints and PostgreSQL schema for users and workouts.

tasks.title: Offline store and sync
tasks.description: Local database on device with a sync queue and retry when online.
acceptance_criteria: Workouts logged in airplane mode appear on the server after reconnecting

tasks.title: Authentication screens
tasks.description: Sign-up and sign-in in the Flutter app.
acceptance_criteria: A user can register and sign in

tasks.title: Progress charts
tasks.description: Weekly and monthly charts from local data.

tasks.title: Push notification reminders
tasks.description: Scheduled reminders via platform push services.
acceptance_criteria: A reminder arrives on a test device

required_approvals.description: Approve scope and the health-data answers before work starts.
